scientific.integrity: The quadratic recurrence reduces exactly to a two-branch multiplicative learning-rate map. A logarithmic coordinate conjugates the invariant-band dynamics to a rigid circle rotation, giving an exact arithmetic classification.
limitations: The theorem is deterministic and scalar.
It concerns the multiplicative normalized hypergradient rule, not additive Hypergradient Descent.
Finite-termination resonances are excluded from the circle-orbit classification.
Multidimensional gradient correlations require separate analysis.

title: Circle-rotation law for multiplicative Hypergradient Descent on a quadratic
